drift_1_bench_prediction_scope.claim_in_paper: Pearson correlations are very high overall (r=0.993) and on each individual benchmark: MATH r=0.984, BBH r=0.992, GPQA r=0.938, IFEval r=0.990, MuSR r=0.734
drift_1_bench_prediction_scope.verdict: Paper cites all_items (train+test combined) but figure uses test_items only. Prose and figure show different values.
drift_1_bench_prediction_scope.action: Rewrite prose to either cite test_items values or clarify that correlation is on all items

drift_2_alignment_tax_log_incomplete.verdict: Paper numbers match v2_alignment_tax.json (statistical_tests.per_benchmark_sem) but NOT the experiment_log entry. Log entry is incomplete.
drift_2_alignment_tax_log_incomplete.action: Re-run alignment_tax script so the log entry contains the primary-benchmark-per-pair stats that the paper cites

drift_3_calibration_minor_inconsistency.verdict: Internal paper inconsistency; log rounds to 0.048
drift_3_calibration_minor_inconsistency.action: Pick one value (0.048 matches log) and use it everywhere

drift_4_math_ece_rounding.verdict: Paper rounds one digit wrong; log rounds to 0.023

results.qmatrix_v2_new_prompt_status: identical to qmatrix_v2_K300 (not a separate variant)
untested_sensitivities: alternative clustering method at K=100 (KMeans, HDBSCAN only in paper as silhouette scores)
alternative LLM prompt for skill extraction
results.verdict: K-sensitivity fully verified and paper matches log exactly. Broader q-matrix sensitivity (clustering method, prompt, embedding) cannot be tested from existing artifacts. Limitation should be acknowledged in paper.

results.reason_suspicious: 'base' models themselves contain alignment markers (SFT/DPO/MDPO). Comparison is aligned-vs-more-aligned, not base-vs-instruct.
results.impact_estimate: 3/84 = 3.6% of pairs. Qwen count would drop 27->24. Aggregate deltas likely shift minimally (these are small 0.5B models), but paper prose '84 matched base-instruct model pairs' overclaims for 3 of them.
results.verdict: Heuristic is mechanically correct but semantically loose. Fix: add exclusion filter in find_pairs() for base names containing SFT/DPO/MDPO/ORPO/etc. Then re-run and update numbers.
